name: A10-0145/2026 – Loránt Vincze, Charles Goerens – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT European political parties and foundations – 2026 report on the application of Regulation (EU, Euratom) No 2025/2445 and on the activities funded
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how European political parties and foundations are funded. It says foundations do important work but lack money and face too much paperwork. It asks the European Commission to review the funding rules and propose changes. These include letting the EU budget cover all of a foundation's eligible costs, raising the limit on donations, and giving foundations more money in the next long-term EU budget.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It asks the Commission to propose new funding rules.
- **Who it affects:** European political foundations and the parties linked to them.
- **What happens next:** The Commission has one year to report, and may propose changes.
